headline: Djibouti Secures $85 Million Annual Defense Deal with France
summary: Djibouti renewed its defense cooperation agreement with France, securing an $85 million annual payment while reclaiming 40% of the French naval installation on Heron Island.
why: Djibouti hosts multiple foreign military bases, making strategic defense agreements a significant component of its national revenues and geopolitical standing.

impacts.name: Djibouti
impacts.why: The defense agreement guarantees substantial annual state revenues.
